g.text: A year calendar for every latitude. Gold: the sea is warming. Blue: it is cooling.
89% of spawning nights fall while the local sea warms, just 47% of the year.
Both hemispheres spawn while the water warms
1,026 spawning nights, 1978–2019, of which 884 lie inside NOAA reef regions. Background colour: 39-year average from 214 regions. North: above 15° N. South: below 10° S.
People look for spawning when they expect it, so quiet months are under-recorded. Sources: Baird et al. (2021), NOAA Coral Reef Watch.
